Summary: Add a member to a channel
Description: Adds a member to a channel in Microsoft Teams

Summary: Add a member to a team tag
Description: Adds a user to a team tag

Summary: Add a member to a team
Description: Adds a member to a team in Microsoft Teams

Summary: Get an @mention token for a team tag
Description: Creates a token that can be inserted into a message or adaptive card sent as a user in a channel to @mention a team tag.

Summary: Get an @mention token for a user
Description: Creates a token that can be inserted into a message or adaptive card to @mention a user.

Summary: Create a team
Description: Creates a new team in Microsoft Teams

Summary: Create a channel
Description: Create a new channel within a specified team

Summary: Create a chat
Description: Creates a one on one or group chat

Summary: Create a tag for a team
Description: Creates a tag in a team

Summary: Create a Teams meeting
Description: Create a meeting with a link at the bottom of the invite to join the meeting online on Microsoft Teams.

Summary: Delete a team tag
Description: Deletes a tag from a team

Summary: Delete a member from a team tag
Description: Deletes a member from a team tag

Summary: List associated teams
Description: Lists all the teams you are a direct member of, or are a member of a shared channel that is hosted inside the team.

Summary: List all channels
Description: Lists all the channels for a specific team, including channels that are shared with the team

Summary: List joined teams
Description: Lists all the teams in Microsoft Teams that you are a member of

Summary: Get details for a specific channel in a team
Description: Get the channel details

Summary: List channels
Description: Lists all the channels for a specific team

Summary: List chats
Description: Lists recent chats you are a part of

Summary: Get message details
Description: Gets the details of a message in a chat or a channel.

Summary: Get messages in a channel
Description: Gets messages from a channel in a specific team. For shared channels, the team ID must refer to the host team, which is the team that owns the shared channel.

Summary: Get messages in a chat
Description: Retrieves messages from a one on one or group chat

Summary: List the members of a team tag
Description: Lists the members of a team tag

Summary: List all tags for a team
Description: Lists the team's tags

Summary: Get a team
Description: Gets the details for a team in Microsoft Teams.

Summary: Send a Microsoft Graph HTTP request
Description: Construct a Microsoft Graph REST API request to invoke against the Microsoft Teams endpoints. These segments are supported: 1st segment: /teams, /me, /users 2nd segment: channels, chats, installedApps, messages, pinnedMessages, onlineMeetings. Learn more: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/use-the-api

Summary: List members
Description: List direct members of a group chat or a channel

Summary: List replies of a channel message
Description: List replies to a message in a channel in a specific team. For shared channels, the team ID must refer to the host team, which is the team that owns the shared channel.

Summary: Post adaptive card and wait for a response
Description: Posts an adaptive card to a chat or a channel and waits for a response from any user. This will pause the flow until any user responds.

Summary: Post card in a chat or channel
Description: Posts a card to a chat or a channel

Summary: Post a feed notification
Description: Posts a notification to a user's activity feed linking to a chat or team.

Summary: Post message in a chat or channel
Description: Posts a message to a chat or a channel

Summary: Remove a direct member from a channel
Description: Removes a direct member from a channel in Microsoft Teams

Summary: Reply with an adaptive card in a channel
Description: Replies with an adaptive card to a channel's message

Summary: Reply with a message in a channel
Description: Replies with a message to a channel's message

Summary: Post a choice of options as the Flow bot to a user
Description: Send a set of options to a Microsoft Teams user, that they must respond to before the flow will continue. This action will pause the flow until the user response to the options

Summary: Update an adaptive card in a chat or channel
Description: Updates an existing adaptive card
